summary: Keeps browser session authentication on the resolved tenant route so SaaS refresh and profile requests reach the assigned shard.
userImpact: Tenant-qualified SaaS pages can restore and refresh browser sessions without showing tenant_route_required errors.
Unauthenticated tenant login pages no longer emit a token-refresh warning while checking for an existing session.

instructions: Deploy this frontend-host patch together with a tenant edge that accepts the existing X-Tenant-Slug browser routing hint.

notes: The fix changes request routing only and does not alter TypeORM entities, migrations, or database-specific behavior.

security: The tenant slug is a shard-routing hint only; refresh tokens remain HTTP-only, tenant-bound, membership-checked, and revocation-checked credentials.
The SaaS edge does not forward the unsigned hint as tenant authority, and canonical tenant routes continue to use signed placement assertions.
documentation: The generated technical release notes describe the tenant-qualified SaaS browser-session routing fix and coordinated deployment requirement.
rollback: Redeploy the previous frontend-host and tenant-edge images; no database rollback is required.
validation: Frontend unit tests cover tenant shard hints on refresh and current-session requests.
Cloud edge and browser checks cover tenant login without tenant_route_required console or network failures.
